# Budget Buddy

> A friendly income and expense tracker that runs entirely in the browser. Log transactions by category, set a monthly budget, see where the money went and compare the last six months.

Budget Buddy is a portfolio project by Harsh Narain, written in plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript with Chart.js. There's no account or server: transactions are saved in the visitor's own browser (localStorage). A "try it with sample data" button fills it with four months of example transactions.

## Page

- [Tracker](./): Balance, this month's income and spending, a monthly budget ring, spending by category, a six-month trend, and the transaction list with search, filters, delete and undo. New transactions are added from a sheet with emoji categories.

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/hersh11/budget-tracker-basic)
